image.alt: Gender Equality in STEM International Workshop 2026

title: Gender Equality in STEM International Workshop 2026
description: Submit a research abstract on gender equality in STEM and present it at a workshop in New Delhi. For researchers and practitioners working on STEM and gender inclusion.
descriptionDetailed: The fourth edition of this international workshop series, hosted by Zakir Husain Centre for Educational Studies at Jawaharlal Nehru University with Heidelberg University, examines why women remain underrepresented in STEM education and careers. Around 30 selected participants discuss structural barriers, workplace practices, cultural norms, and inclusive approaches through research presentations and working sessions. Attendance is free, though participants cover their own travel.

entry.feeNote: There are no costs for workshop attendance; participants cover their own travel.

audience.eligibilityLabel: Open to researchers on gender and STEM
audience.eligibilityDetail: Researchers from any discipline whose work relates to gender and STEM, plus STEM practitioners interested in gender equality, may apply by submitting an abstract of up to 350 words. Participation is limited to around 30 selected candidates.
